note: Highest flood-risk level SWALIM published per river-season, 2006-2023, on SWALIM's ladder (moderate flood risk < high flood risk or flood alert < bank full or overflow). The framework lets a SWALIM moderate flood risk alert for either river reach the readiness trigger, so a season counts for the SWALIM route when its level is moderate or higher. Sources: the SWALIM bulletin archive on blob (ds-aa-som-floods/raw/swalim/alerts) and ReliefWeb for 2006-2014, read season by season on 2026-09-06/07 (pages/trigger-single-model, sections 'SWALIM's alerts' and 'SWALIM in quiet seasons'); 2024 weekly bulletins for Gu 2024. 'none found' means no bulletin was located for the season; 'none' means bulletins exist but state no risk above minimal. The archive has no bulletins before 2006.
